candidate_source.title: Omnivorous person, number and gender in Mundari: A Cyclic Agree analysis

scope_classification.class: peer-reviewed linguistic research / open-access accepted manuscript

exact_locator_evidence.locator: accepted manuscript PDF p. 2 (PDF index P1), abstract
exact_locator_evidence.supported_statement: The authors analyze a Mundari agreement pattern in which person, number and an animacy-based gender restriction interact in object marking.

exact_locator_evidence.locator: accepted manuscript PDF p. 3 (PDF index P2), lines corresponding to example (3)
exact_locator_evidence.supported_statement: The manuscript states the analyzed person hierarchy as 1 > 2 > 3 and number hierarchy as sg > pl > du, with eligibility constrained by animacy in the described object-marking pattern.

exact_locator_evidence.locator: accepted manuscript PDF p. 6 (PDF index P5), footnote 6
exact_locator_evidence.supported_statement: The authors state that, unless otherwise noted, the Mundari data used in the analysis come from fieldwork carried out in Jharkhand, India.
